attributes.Product description: The ELIKAI 4-in-1 Defrosting Tray for Frozen Meat is built for cooks who refuse to waste time waiting on a slow thaw. Thaw a one-inch steak in roughly 30 to 45 minutes at room temperature on this thawing tray. Grooved channels along the perimeter catch melt and drip runoff so your countertop stays dry. The non-porous defrosting plate surface resists odor absorption, ensuring your next ingredient starts fresh every time. Use it as a plate with grater when you need to prep garlic or hard spices quickly. Constructed from polypropylene bonded to the aluminum thaw core, the meat defrosting tray resists warping, staining, and knife scarring. A non-slip rubber base grips the countertop firmly, keeping these cutting boards for kitchen prep stable during heavy chopping. The entire unit is dishwasher safe on the top rack for effortless cleanup after every meal. Available in red and white, and in small and large sizes to fit any kitchen layout. Whether you need a reliable meat thawer or a sturdy defrosting tray for frozen meat that handles slicing, dicing, and thawing in one board, this multi-functional tool replaces several single-purpose items and makes a thoughtful gift for any occasion.
attributes.feature_1: Four Tools, One Board: This ELIKAI defrosting tray for frozen meat combines an aluminum-core thawing plate, knife refiner, garlic grater, and reversible cutting board into one compact kitchen tool. attributes.feature_2: Two Sides, Double Duty: Flip between the aluminum-core thawing surface and a polypropylene defrosting board in seconds, no extra tools needed. One side draws ambient heat into frozen cuts for steady, even defrosting while the other handles slicing, dicing, and chopping on a non-porous surface that resists stains. A built-in knife refiner and garlic grater plate round out the versatile design.
attributes.feature_3: Faster, Safer Thawing: Place frozen meat on the aluminum-core meat thawing tray and let natural heat conduction do the work. A one-inch steak thaws in roughly 30 to 45 minutes at room temperature (77 degrees farenheit), with no hot water or microwave needed. Grooved edges catch drips and runoff, keeping your countertop clean while this meat defrosting tray surface stays non-porous, stain-free, and odor-resistant.
attributes.feature_4: Compact Prep Surface: At 14.6"L x 9.8"W x 0.34"Th, these cutting boards for kitchen prep fit neatly on smaller countertops while giving you generous room for everyday slicing and dicing. The BPA-free polypropylene defrosting board resists knife marks and warping, while the non-slip rubber base keeps this defroster stable on any countertop. Available in red and white to suit your kitchen.
attributes.feature_5: Practical Kitchen Gift: Looking for a useful kitchen gift? This thawing tray for frozen meat combines four tools in one compact board that saves counter space. The non-porous surface is dishwasher safe on the top rack for easy cleanup, and the durable polypropylene build handles daily use without warping or staining. A smart, space-saving meat thawer for birthdays, housewarmings, or any cook.
attributes.feature_6: Perfect for busy professionals and families who need quick, hassle‑free meal prep. Home cooks and kitchen enthusiasts love the efficiency of defrosting meats without a microwave. Use on a kitchen countertop or dinner prep station.

attributes.Product description: These precision miter shears are the perfect solution for cutting wood trim, moulding, and quarter round with accuracy and ease. The ergonomic handles provide a comfortable grip and excellent leverage, reducing hand fatigue during extended use. The sharp, durable blades cut cleanly through wood trim materials, creating smooth edges that fit together seamlessly. This multifunctional tool is ideal for baseboards, crown molding, door frames, and other finish carpentry applications. Whether you're a professional contractor or a DIY enthusiast tackling home improvement projects, these miter shears offer portability and convenience that traditional cutting tools can't match. The compact design makes them easy to transport to job sites and store in your toolbox. Perfect for quick touch-ups, repairs, or installations where setting up a full miter saw would be impractical.

attributes.Product description: Ground turmeric root, also known as Indian saffron and yellow root, is a bright yellow powder dried and ground from the rhizome of the Curcuma longa root, which is a member of the ginger (Zingiberacea) family. Turmeric's warm aroma, bright colour, and gingery/peppery taste are relied upon in cooking throughout Asia, and it's best known as the spice that gives curry powder its distinctive colour. Simply Organic's turmeric powder boasts a deep golden-yellow colour and a distinctive, pungent aroma, and its flavour resembles both ginger and pepper. Indispensable in curry powders and East Indian cooking, turmeric is also used in mustards, dressings, eggs and rice dishes. Our turmeric spice is certified USDA Organic, non-GMO, and Kosher so you can feel good about stocking it in your pantry. We support and encourage the growth of organic farming practices and are committed to integrity in products and the way we do business. With Simply Organic you can feel good about the food on your table and its effect on the world we live in.

attributes.description: If you're looking to start your collection of the prettiest glue guns or to be the best gift giver look no further, you'll save big with our Ultimate Lynn Lilly Kit. Complete with all our best-selling glue sticks you'll be ready for any crafting or DIY project you'd like to conquer. Kit includes both special edition Lynn Lilly cordless/corded battery-free glue guns, the full-size, and the mini-size detail tip. Created in partnership with craft maven, designer, and on-air personality Lynn Lilly and Surebonder®, the leading glue gun manufacturer. With its vibrant turquoise body and bright pink accents, the Lynn Lilly by Surebonder® glue guns stand out from the crowd. But it's not just about looks - these glue guns are packed with features. With no battery to charge you'll never have to stop the creative process. Both glue guns can be used cordless for up to 2 minutes off the base, giving you freedom to move about and crafting convenience. When you need uninterrupted power, simply plug in the cord to the bottom of the glue gun and continue working without any limitations. These high-temperature glue guns are also leading in safety with features like; an insulated nozzle cover, a heating stand with an attached glue pad, side fins to lay the glue gun down on its side without worry of glue back up, a safety fuse, and an on-off switch. The full-size has a powerful 60-watt design allowing you to spend more time creating and less time waiting for your glue to be ready and the mini-size has a detail tip perfect for precision work. The kit also includes our all-purpose (mini and full size) 5 ft glue rolls, and 10-inch glue sticks, formulated with high-quality materials for a strong and durable bond. Our best-selling fabric glue with a flexible and durable bond that is machine washable in cold, in mini, and full size. As well as our 19" x 19" pink silicone mat, it protects your work surface in style and function. Glue peels right off and paint washes off making cleanup a breeze.

attributes.Colour: Deep Blue, Sky Blue, Light Blue, White
attributes.Recommended uses for product: Food preparation, including cutting vegetables, fruits, seafood, raw and cooked meats, and for kitchen and camping use. See more
attributes.Recommended Uses For Product: Food preparation, including cutting vegetables, fruits, seafood, raw and cooked meats, and for kitchen and camping use.
attributes.feature_1: 【Essential Kitchen Set】To avoid confusion during chopping board usage, we designed four boards in different colors for handling vegetables, seafood, raw meat, and cooked food respectively. Additionally, the markings and colors on the boards help distinguish raw and cooked food in a more hygienic manner. The reversible chopping boards effectively prevent food from absorbing odors, allowing you to enjoy the original flavors of your meals.
attributes.feature_2: 【Non-slip Feet】Each cutting board has anti slip feet around it, which can tightly grip the tabletop, so there is no need to worry about it slipping off when cutting food. There is also a handle on the edge of the cutting board that can help you easily transfer food from the counter to the cookware.
attributes.feature_3: 【Unique Design】The cutting board is designed differently for different types of food. There is a protrusion on one side of the raw food cutting board that can help you handle smooth fish and prevent cutting your hands. The edges of vegetable and raw meat cutting boards have grooves that can collect juice and prevent stains. The surface of the cooked food board has larger grooves, making it easier to grab breadcrumbs and easier to tip over.
attributes.feature_4: 【Materials & Sturdy】Wheat straw is a new type of renewable natural composite material that does not contain bisphenol A and is healthy. Compared to wooden cutting boards, plastic composite materials make cutting boards more hygienic, less prone to mold, and do not require the use of special adhesive oils for careful care. More importantly, it is very hard, not easily deformed or bent, and will not leave scratches easily when used with a sharp knife.
attributes.feature_5: 【Cleaning & Storage】Our plastic cutting boards have a smooth and even surface, unlike wooden cutting boards that leave difficult to clean food residue.
